source_title: All Big Upcoming PS5 Games For 2026 & Beyond
source_excerpt:
The following PlayStation 5 games were added on October 30, 2026 : Pit of Goblin, VOID/BREAKER, Worship, Outbreak: Dead City, Dominus Gladiatus, Dark Alley, Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School, Faraway, Shrek 2 Remastered, MARVEL Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom, Hazard Levels, Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea, Dark Rail, Goat Simulator 3: Ticket to Dizzyworld, Sunstone of Time, Fallen City Brawl, GrimKeep, Luma Island, The Road of Dust and Sorrow, Edge of Memories, E.S.D.E., Waltz and Jam, Guns of Eschaton, Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey, BrokenLore: Ascend, Sturmjager, Arizona Sunshine, Villion:Code, Tropico 7, Elta: Defy All Gods, He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction, Spyder: Agent 8, Psikyo Memories, Grave Seasons, The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother,
While the console is on shakier ground than usual right now, the PS5 game release calendar is nevertheless stacked to the brim with new titles for the end of 2026 and early 2027. Starting in November, each month contains at least a couple of major names, be it GTA 6 , Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World , Stranger Than Heaven , Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis , Wo Long 2 , God of War: Laufey , and Final Fantasy 7 Revelation .
As it can be a bit challenging to keep track of all the upcoming PlayStation 5 games, I've put this article together to provide some guidance and help ensure you don't miss out on anything you might want to play. We have open-world RPGs , FPS games, PS5 exclusives, and more to look forward to. Let the gaming continue.
